claim: A currency whose street premium widens by more than 5 points in a day while its official rate barely moves is a street-price story, a currency pulling away from its official rate.
calculation: Every trigger in data/stress_signal.csv. A currency flagged in data/official_rate_flags.csv (a looping, jumping, frozen or lagging official rate) is skipped: its trigger comes from the official rate breaking, not the street. For each other trigger, the street price's own move: the day's median of the buy price on the Binance board (data/p2p_basis.csv, buy_median, source_ok) against the day before. The trigger survives when the street price moved 3% or more in the direction of the widening. The figure is the share of all stored triggers that survive.
window: every stored trigger, since the record started on 10 Sep
invalid_if: data/official_rate_flags.csv or data/p2p_basis.csv is missing, or fewer than 10 triggers are stored
thresholds_text: holds: at least half of the stored triggers survive. weaker: at least a quarter. no longer true: fewer than a quarter, which means most triggers came from a broken official rate or a street price that barely moved.
trigger: a new trigger, or a new day of the official-rate flags
proposed_by: Claude, 22 Oct 2026, from SEB-311 step 2; the thresholds are proposals, merged by Seb's 20 Oct rule, and change only through a spec
